title: Connect Finance Property Operating Results v1
description: The monthly recurring operating statement for one church-owned commercial property (3277 Ivanhoe by default): one row per report month from finance_property_monthly, plus the same per-fiscal-year annualSummary production's own `finance/property/<key>` GET route already returns alongside it (computePropertyAnnualSummary, src/api-finance.js). A different shape from connect.finance-property-reserves.v1 (a reserve funding schedule) and connect.finance-property-ledgers.v1 (itemized one-off ledgers) -- the same reasoning that kept Balance Sheet/Church Report separate from Budget. Confirmed live against production on 2026-09-15: occupancy_pct is a 0-1 fraction (not the committed synthetic fixture's 0-100 scale), and total_expenses_cents/net_operating_income_cents/available_for_distribution_cents/reserve_balance_cents/loan_payment_cents/interest_expense_cents are all genuinely nullable -- several months' AHRA reports simply don't break out those figures.

propertyKey.description: Defaults to 'ivanhoe' -- the only property Finance/Connect track today.

periods.description: One row per report month. Empty is a normal, valid 'nothing reported yet' state -- same convention as Budget/Church Report/Balance Sheet/Daycare Report's own empty-fiscal-year contracts, not a 500.

annualSummary.description: Reused directly from computePropertyAnnualSummary (src/api-finance.js), not reimplemented -- the exact per-fiscal-year rollup production's own Property tab already presents.

occupancyPct.description: A 0-1 fraction (0.893 = 89.3% occupied), confirmed against real production data on 2026-09-15 -- not the 0-100 scale the committed synthetic fixture happens to store.

totalExpensesCents.description: Nullable -- 4 of 30 real rows for 'ivanhoe' have no total_expenses_cents on 2026-09-15. When present, totalRevenueCents - totalExpensesCents must equal netIncomeCents exactly (confirmed against all 26 such real rows).

loanPaymentCents.description: Nullable -- populated for only 1 of 30 real rows on 2026-09-15 (the one month a lender-confirmed loan payment/interest split was recorded).

totalExpensesCents.description: A month with no total_expenses_cents has its expenses derived as totalRevenueCents - netIncomeCents for that month, same as computePropertyAnnualSummary's own documented convention.

avgOccupancyPct.description: Average of the year's periods' occupancyPct (same 0-1 fraction scale), or null if no period that year carried an occupancy figure.

confirmedDistributionsCents.description: Sum of finance_property_distributions for this year -- confirmed cash distributions, distinct from availableForDistributionCents (an estimate).

expenseMonthsDerived.description: How many of this year's months had their expenses derived rather than reported, so the UI can say so.
